label: ZT NY open gap fade (December filter)
researchSummary: Tests whether the overnight gap fades or continues during a specific NY cash-session window. Filtered by signalMonth=12.
selectionMethod: Pre-2022 train-score rank, then post-2022 forward qualification. No parameters were fit on post-2022 data. Management sweep promoted `be_trail_prior_bar_b2` only after strict forward PF improved from 2.22 to 2.55.
verificationSummary: Management sweep `be_trail_prior_bar_b2` strict PF 2.55 over 62 trades, beating baseline PF 2.22; train PF 0.83, bootstrap p05 1.50, block-bootstrap p05 1.62, odd/even min PF 1.53, annual pass rate 100%.
